<div class="excalidraw-svg"><svg version="1.1" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 989.1512788653906 670.9720580080457" width="989.1512788653906" height="670.9720580080457" class="excalidraw-svg" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto;"><!-- svg-source:excalidraw --><metadata/><defs><symbol id="image-fa475edfd0d05a8532f64264890fca85a103e680"><image href="data:image/jpeg;base64," preserveAspectRatio="none" width="100%" height="100%"/></symbol><style class="style-fonts">      @font-face { font-family: "Lilita One"; src: url(data:font/woff2;base64,); }</style></defs><rect x="0" y="0" width="989.1512788653906" height="670.9720580080457" fill="#ffffff"/><g transform="translate(610 110) rotate(0 184.5756394326953 275.48602900402284)"><use href="#image-fa475edfd0d05a8532f64264890fca85a103e680" width="369" height="551" opacity="1"/></g><g transform="translate(610 10) rotate(0 180.5587615966797 48.30000000000001)"><text x="0" y="25.942" font-family="Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji" font-size="28px" fill="#1e1e1e" text-anchor="start" style="white-space: pre;" direction="ltr" dominant-baseline="alphabetic"/><text x="0" y="58.141999999999996" font-family="Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji" font-size="28px" fill="#1e1e1e" text-anchor="start" style="white-space: pre;" direction="ltr" dominant-baseline="alphabetic">WIR SIND SO GLÜCKLICH</text><text x="0" y="90.34199999999998" font-family="Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji" font-size="28px" fill="#1e1e1e" text-anchor="start" style="white-space: pre;" direction="ltr" dominant-baseline="alphabetic">WIR LIEBEN ALLE DEN SCHEIN</text></g><g transform="translate(10 130) rotate(0 300 57.5)"><text x="0" y="18.53" font-family="Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji" font-size="20px" fill="#1e1e1e" text-anchor="start" style="white-space: pre;" direction="ltr" dominant-baseline="alphabetic">The image used is a mass-produced, plastic crucifix—already an icon</text><text x="0" y="41.53" font-family="Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji" font-size="20px" fill="#1e1e1e" text-anchor="start" style="white-space: pre;" direction="ltr" dominant-baseline="alphabetic">made kitsch through capitalism. By submerging it in urine, Serrano</text><text x="0" y="64.53" font-family="Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji" font-size="20px" fill="#1e1e1e" text-anchor="start" style="white-space: pre;" direction="ltr" dominant-baseline="alphabetic">draws attention to how religious symbols have become commodified</text><text x="0" y="87.53" font-family="Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji" font-size="20px" fill="#1e1e1e" text-anchor="start" style="white-space: pre;" direction="ltr" dominant-baseline="alphabetic">objects, stripped of their spiritual intensity. Capitalism, not Serrano,</text><text x="0" y="110.53" font-family="Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji" font-size="20px" fill="#1e1e1e" text-anchor="start" style="white-space: pre;" direction="ltr" dominant-baseline="alphabetic">is the true desecrator.</text></g><g transform="translate(10 30) rotate(0 290 46)"><text x="0" y="18.53" font-family="Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji" font-size="20px" fill="#1e1e1e" text-anchor="start" style="white-space: pre;" direction="ltr" dominant-baseline="alphabetic">Serrano's photograph Immersion (Piss Christ) is not an attack on</text><text x="0" y="41.53" font-family="Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji" font-size="20px" fill="#1e1e1e" text-anchor="start" style="white-space: pre;" direction="ltr" dominant-baseline="alphabetic">Christianity, but a transgressive reclamation of Christ's humanity</text><text x="0" y="64.53" font-family="Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji" font-size="20px" fill="#1e1e1e" text-anchor="start" style="white-space: pre;" direction="ltr" dominant-baseline="alphabetic">through the medium of bodily fluid. It critiques the commodification</text><text x="0" y="87.53" font-family="Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji" font-size="20px" fill="#1e1e1e" text-anchor="start" style="white-space: pre;" direction="ltr" dominant-baseline="alphabetic">of the sacred more than the sacred itself.</text></g><g transform="translate(10 250) rotate(0 290 57.5)"><text x="0" y="18.53" font-family="Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji" font-size="20px" fill="#1e1e1e" text-anchor="start" style="white-space: pre;" direction="ltr" dominant-baseline="alphabetic">Mainstream Christian imagery often sanitises the crucifixion of</text><text x="0" y="41.53" font-family="Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji" font-size="20px" fill="#1e1e1e" text-anchor="start" style="white-space: pre;" direction="ltr" dominant-baseline="alphabetic">Jesus, making it bloodless, distant, aestheticised, as if only the</text><text x="0" y="64.53" font-family="Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji" font-size="20px" fill="#1e1e1e" text-anchor="start" style="white-space: pre;" direction="ltr" dominant-baseline="alphabetic">sterile can be holy. It was not God’s hands nailed to the cross, but a</text><text x="0" y="87.53" font-family="Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji" font-size="20px" fill="#1e1e1e" text-anchor="start" style="white-space: pre;" direction="ltr" dominant-baseline="alphabetic">human’s. Serrano puts the body back into Christ—flesh, pain, piss</text><text x="0" y="110.53" font-family="Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji" font-size="20px" fill="#1e1e1e" text-anchor="start" style="white-space: pre;" direction="ltr" dominant-baseline="alphabetic">and all.</text></g><g transform="translate(10 370) rotate(0 285.48974609375 46)"><text x="0" y="18.53" font-family="Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji" font-size="20px" fill="#1e1e1e" text-anchor="start" style="white-space: pre;" direction="ltr" dominant-baseline="alphabetic">The submersion of Jesus into urine is a reversal of baptism, brought</text><text x="0" y="41.53" font-family="Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji" font-size="20px" fill="#1e1e1e" text-anchor="start" style="white-space: pre;" direction="ltr" dominant-baseline="alphabetic">into the world through waste, not water. It’s sacrament. If baptism</text><text x="0" y="64.53" font-family="Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji" font-size="20px" fill="#1e1e1e" text-anchor="start" style="white-space: pre;" direction="ltr" dominant-baseline="alphabetic">is about entering the divine, Piss Christ is about God entering the</text><text x="0" y="87.53" font-family="Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji" font-size="20px" fill="#1e1e1e" text-anchor="start" style="white-space: pre;" direction="ltr" dominant-baseline="alphabetic">human, through degradation.</text></g><g transform="translate(10 470) rotate(0 300 80.5)"><text x="0" y="18.53" font-family="Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji" font-size="20px" fill="#1e1e1e" text-anchor="start" style="white-space: pre;" direction="ltr" dominant-baseline="alphabetic">Immersion was vandalised in 2011, but it drew controversy long</text><text x="0" y="41.53" font-family="Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji" font-size="20px" fill="#1e1e1e" text-anchor="start" style="white-space: pre;" direction="ltr" dominant-baseline="alphabetic">before then. Some Christians consider it blasphemy. But the anger</text><text x="0" y="64.53" font-family="Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji" font-size="20px" fill="#1e1e1e" text-anchor="start" style="white-space: pre;" direction="ltr" dominant-baseline="alphabetic">often directed at the work says more about the viewer’s assumptions</text><text x="0" y="87.53" font-family="Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji" font-size="20px" fill="#1e1e1e" text-anchor="start" style="white-space: pre;" direction="ltr" dominant-baseline="alphabetic">than the image itself. What actually is desecrated in Piss Christ? Is it</text><text x="0" y="110.53" font-family="Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji" font-size="20px" fill="#1e1e1e" text-anchor="start" style="white-space: pre;" direction="ltr" dominant-baseline="alphabetic">the sacred, or is it how we believe the sacred should be visualised?</text><text x="0" y="133.53" font-family="Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji" font-size="20px" fill="#1e1e1e" text-anchor="start" style="white-space: pre;" direction="ltr" dominant-baseline="alphabetic">Serrano dares to ask: do you worship Christ, or the idea of Christ? The</text><text x="0" y="156.53" font-family="Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji" font-size="20px" fill="#1e1e1e" text-anchor="start" style="white-space: pre;" direction="ltr" dominant-baseline="alphabetic">man, or the merchandise?</text></g></svg></div>
